verdict.rationale: The pack includes Datadog's API Reference page, but only as a title and a URL ending in '/api/latest/'. Neither that item nor any other states that the APIs are versioned or describes a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every path. A URL slug alone does not show the product documents API versioning and deprecation, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
